messages:
elaine-support: FYI, just got a ticket from AcmeInc — they say trial credits aren’t decrementing even though API calls succeeded. Customer attached request ids and example payloads.
mark-eng: can you paste one of the request_ids and a timestamp? also whether they used the hosted API or a dedicated instance.
elaine-support: hosted API. request_id: req_0a1b2c3d4e, reported at 2025-10-18T16:12:07Z. Customer says response was a 200 with tokens=1.2 but balance stayed the same.
junior-billing: can we see ledger rows for that user id (acme_inc_trial_118)? small chance the grant and consumption landed in different partitions.
elaine-support: attaching excerpts from customer (redacted):
```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer sk-live-...redacted
X-Request-ID: req_0a1b2c3d4e
{"model":"redwood-v2-medium","input":"hello","max_tokens":50}
response: 200, tokens_used: 1.2, model_cost: 0.00012
```
mark-eng: thanks. sara-data, can you join — we need to correlate request_id -> internal usage event -> billing ledger entry.
sara-data: looked up req_0a1b2c3d4e in usage events: shows a successful token event at 2025-10-18T16:12:07Z with event_id ev_9922, user_id acme_inc_trial_118, tokens 1.2. However ledger entries for that user show a grant of 500 trial credits at 2025-10-18T16:11:59Z (grant_id g_44) then a ledger write at 2025-10-18T16:12:15Z that zeroed the balance back to 500.
mark-eng: interesting — so usage event existed but final balance unchanged. That suggests ledger reconciliation or a subsequent write overwrote consumption. any writes around 16:12:15?
junior-billing: yes that matches an async promo-reconcile job that runs when grants are issued to ensure idempotency — it does a write-if-not-exists but there was a race. The grant and the reconcile job both tried to init balance; reconcile used stale snapshot and re-wrote 500.
ben-platform: that reconcile job should be compare-and-set. which datastore op is it using? if it’s a blind put we can see this behavior.
sara-data: it's using a conditional write previously, but we rolled back a guard in last week's deploy for perf (see changelist CL-1943). I can see reconcile job logs:
```
2025-10-18T16:11:59Z grant g_44 created
2025-10-18T16:12:05Z usage ev_9922 recorded
2025-10-18T16:12:15Z reconcile job ran, wrote balance=500 (overwrote 499.8)
```
mark-eng: ok root cause = reconcile job overwrote recent consumption due to stale read window. repro steps: create grant, immediately call API; observe usage event present but final balance equal to grant.
elaine-support: customer impacted count? only AcmeInc reported so far. Should we proactively check other recent grants?
junior-billing: running a query for grants in last 2 hours with reconcile job writes that overlap usage window. early results: ~18 customers had reconcile writes within 30s of usage events — about 4 show discrepancy.
ben-platform: mitigation — pause reconcile jobs for new grants and re-enable CAS guard. I can push abort for the job scheduler now.
prodops-bot: job scheduler: reconcile-grants-v2 paused by ben-platform at 2025-10-18T17:05:12Z.
mark-eng: quick patch plan: restore CAS check in reconcile job (re-add conditional write) + add a backfill that consumes usage events to replay ledger delta for affected accounts. estimate 2-3 hours.
sara-data: I’ll prepare reconciliation script to idempotently apply usage events that are missing. Need list of affected user_ids and the last_consume_cursor.
junior-billing: for immediate customer remediation we should manual-credit/deduct so their UI shows correct balance. for AcmeInc I recommend manual deduct of 1.2 tokens (or manual sync). Elaine — can you offer that and apologize?
elaine-support: will do. sending customer a temporary credit-sync and note about root cause + ETA for fix.
mark-eng: follow-up actions: 1) revert CL-1943 change in reconcile job (hotfix), 2) add a test that simulates grant+usage race, 3) backfill script run and verification, 4) monitoring rule to alert when ledger writes decrease after a grant without corresponding usage events.
ben-platform: I’ll open an infra change with rollback and coordinate release window.
elaine-support: customer updated: accepted temporary manual sync, asked for confirmation once backfill completes. I’ll keep thread updated.
prodops-bot: incident ticket created: INC-2025-7405 with severity P3 — assigned to billing and platform.
mark-eng: thanks all — please post final postmortem here after remediation.
elaine-support: noted, closing customer loop after backfill.
